evidence: Diff commit message: 'a SUBCLASS, so every existing `except CommandError` and the exit-1/returncode contract still catch it unchanged — backward-compatible'

search across repo shows the only SecretScreenRefused reference in tests is the docstring at test_sidecar_secret_screen_surfacing_4802.py:12 — no assertion exercises `isinstance(SecretScreenRefused(...), CommandError)` or the returncode/exit-1 behavior
advisory.finding: The backward-compatibility contract that SecretScreenRefused is a CommandError subclass (so every existing `except CommandError` and the exit-1/returncode contract still catch it) is asserted nowhere; a refactor changing the base class would silently break those callers with no failing test.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a unit test: `from rebar._commands._seam import CommandError, SecretScreenRefused; e = SecretScreenRefused('x'); assert isinstance(e, CommandError); assert getattr(e, 'returncode', None) == getattr(CommandError('x'), 'returncode', None)`.
